content: Ye bɑ kɑ kpɑkoro te tunumɑ, yerɑ bɑ tu doke ten ɑyerɔ kuu bekuruɡiru sɔɔ te Dɑfidi u kuɑ ten sɔ̃. Yen biruwɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ.
Ye Dɑfidi u yɑ̃ku ni kuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ domɑru kuɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru.
Mɑ u be kpuro dĩɑnu bɔnu kuɑ, tɔn kurɔbu kɑ tɔn durɔbu. U bɑɑwure pɛ̃ɛ kɑ yɑɑ wɔ̃ɔrɑ wɛ̃ kɑ sere mɑɑ kirɑ te bɑ kuɑ kɑ resɛm ɡbebɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Lefi ben ɡɑbu sɔmɑ wɛ̃ woodɑn kpɑkoro ten sɔ̃, kpɑ bu kɑ Gusunɔ be Isirelibɑn Yinni sɑ̃. Kpɑ bu nùn siɑrɑ, kpɑ bu nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.

Asɑfuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben wiruɡii. Mɑ Sɑkɑri u sɑ̃ɑ win yiruse. Mɑ Yeyɛli kɑ Semirɑmɔtu kɑ Yehiɛli kɑ Mɑtitiɑ kɑ Eliɑbu kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ sere Yeyɛli bɑ ɡuunu kɑ mɔrɔkunu soomɔ. Mɑ Asɑfu u mɑɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu soomɔ.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo beni, Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ Yɑsiɛli bɑ kɔbi soomɔ tɑ̃ɑ tɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro ten wuswɑɑɔ.
Tɔ̃ɔ terɑ Dɑfidi u derɑ Asɑfu kɑ wiɡibu bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tɔmɑm toruɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: i Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro, kpɑ i nùn sɑ̃,
kpɑ i bwesenu nɔɔsiɑ sɔm bɑkɑ ni u kuɑ.
I nùn tɔmɔ.
I nùn siɑro kɑ womusu,
kpɑ i win sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinun ɡɑri kpɑrɑ.
I yɛ̃ɛrio win yĩsi dɛɛrɑrun sɔ̃,
kpɑ i nuku dobu ko
bɛɛ bèn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ nùn kɑsu.
I ɡɔsiro Yinni Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡiin mi,
kpɑ i nùn kɑsu bɑɑdommɑ.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, Yɑkɔbu Gusunɔn sɔm kowon bweseru,
bɛɛ be u ɡɔsɑ,
i yɑɑyo sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni u kuɑ
kɑ ɡɑri yi u bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Gusunɔwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn Yinni.
Wiyɑ u koo hɑnduniɑ kpuro siri.
I ɑrukɑwɑni ye yɑɑyo bɑɑdommɑ
ye u kɑ Aburɑhɑmu bɔkuɑ
kɑ mɑɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛ te u Isɑki kuɑ.
U kɑ ye Isirelibɑ, Yɑkɔbun bweseru bɔkuɑwɑ
yɑ n sɑ̃ɑ woodɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U nɛɛ, u koo bu Kɑnɑnin tem wɛ̃
bu tubi di.
N deemɑ sɑnɑm mɛ,
Isirelibɑ bɑ ǹ dɑbi,
mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɔbu tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Bɑ rɑ n dɑɑmɔwɑ bwese tukunun mi
kɑ wuu tukusɔ.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ dere ɡoo u bu dɑm dɔre.
U mɑɑ sinɑmbu sɛɛyɑsiɑ ben sɔ̃.
U nɛɛ, i ku nɛn tɔn be nɑ ɡɔsɑ bɑbɑ.
I ku mɑɑ nɛn sɔmɔbu kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛ hɑnduniɑɡibu,
i Yinni Gusunɔ tɔmɔ.
I win fɑɑbɑn ɡɑri kpɑro tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere.
I win yiikon ɡirimɑ kɑ win sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu kpɑro
bwesenun suunu sɔɔ.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u kpɑ̃.
Wiyɑ n weenɛ bu siɑrɑ.
U bũnu kpuro nɑnum kere.
Bwese tukunun bũnu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑm dirum.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u wɔllu kuɑ.
Yiiko kɑ ɡirimɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ win wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ dɑm kɑ nuku dobu wɑ̃ɑ win wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Bɛɛ bwesenu kpuro,
i Yinni Gusunɔ yiiko kɑ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛyɔ.
I Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru yiiko wɛ̃ɛyɔ.
I kɑ nùn kɛ̃nu dɑɑwo win sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Kpɑ i yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ
i nùn sɑ̃ win dɛɛrɑrun sɔ̃.
Bɛɛ hɑnduniɑɡibu kpuro,
i diirio win wuswɑɑɔ.
Tem mu dɑm mɔ,
mu ǹ bɑ̃ɑrimɔ.
Wɔllu, ɑ yɛ̃ɛrio,
kpɑ tem mu nuku dobu ko.
I bwesenu kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɔ
mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u bɑndu dii.
Nim wɔ̃ku ɡu kuuki koowo,
kɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡe sɔɔ.
Ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡen berɑ mi ɡiɑ kpuro,
yu nuku dobu koowo.
Dɑ̃nu, i nuku dobun kuuki koowo
Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Domi u wee u hɑnduniɑɡibu siri.
I Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro win tɔn ɡeerun sɔ̃.
Win kĩru tɑ ǹ nɔru mɔ.
I nùn nɔɔɡiru sueyo i nɛɛ,
Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Fɑɑbɑ kowo, ɑ sun fɑɑbɑ koowo.
A sun wɔro bwese tukunun nɔmɑn di,
kpɑ ɑ sun mɛnnɑ.
Sɑɑ yerɑ sɑ ko nun tɔmɑ
sɑ n wunɛn yĩsi dɛɛrɑru soku,
kpɑ sɑ n yɛ̃ɛrimɔ, sɑ n mɔ̀,
Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni,
wunɑ bɑ ko n siɑrɑmɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.

content: Mɑ tɔmbu kpuro bɑ nɛɛ, ɑmi! I Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro.
Yen biru Dɑfidi u Asɑfu kɑ wiɡibu yiire bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro ten mi, bɑ n sɔmburu mɔ̀ bɑɑdommɑ.
Mɑ u Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ Hosɑ kɑ beɡibu ɡɔsɑ. Ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɑtɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (68). Obɛdi Edɔmu, Yedutum bii, kɑ Hosɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobu.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yɑ̃ku kowo Sɑdɔku kɑ wiɡibu yiire bu sɔmburu ko ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ Gɑbɑoniɔ, mi bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kuru kue,
bɑ n dɑ nùn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kue bɑɑdommɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ, bururu kɑ yokɑ, kpɑ bu mɑɑ ko kpuro ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ woodɑ sɔɔ ye u Isirelibɑ wɛ̃.
Be sɔɔrɑ Hemɑni kɑ Yedutum kɑ sere be bɑ ɡɔsɑ bɑ ben yĩsɑ siɑ siɑ mi, bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Domi wi, Yinni Gusunɔn tɔn ɡeeru tɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Hemɑni kɑ Yedutum, berɑ bɑ rɑ kɔbi kɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu kɑ sere mɑɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni nu tien wunɑnɔsu ko, ni bɑ rɑ kɑ womusu ko bɑ̀ n Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Yedutum bibɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ kɔnnɔn kɔ̃sobu.
Yen biru, tɔmbu kpuro bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ wurɑ ben yɛnusɔ. Mɑ Dɑfidi u mɑɑ dɑ win yɛnuɔ u kɑ win yɛnuɡibu domɑru kuɑ.
